description:
My Property Box are pleased to bring back to the lettings market this charming two bedroom home, situated within the popular Micklewood development in Longhirst.

Located just a few miles from the market town of Morpeth, the property is ideally positioned for access to local amenities, as well as the A1 motorway. Set within a peaceful rural development, it provides a quiet and safe environment while still offering excellent transport links. The property has been finished to a high standard throughout, featuring a modern kitchen with integrated appliances and tasteful décor. The accommodation is offered unfurnished.

The entrance hallway leads through to a downstairs WC, with the property then opening into a spacious open-plan living room and kitchen. Patio doors provide access to the rear garden. To the first floor are two double bedrooms, a useful storage cupboard and a modern family bathroom.

To arrange a viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak with our Lettings Team.
